finding.title: The `intersection` array is declared with a fixed size of 10. If the intersection of `arr1` and `arr2` has more than 10 elements, this will lead to a buffer overflow.
The `size3` variable is passed by reference but is not initialized before being used.

scan_patch.message: Parameter 'arr1' can be declared as const array
Parameter 'arr2' can be declared as const array

findings.description: The `intersection` array is declared with a fixed size of 10. If the intersection of `arr1` and `arr2` has more than 10 elements, this will lead to a buffer overflow.
